records.title: B Site Pre-round Razorvine While the Team Anchors A
records.description: During the buy phase, use the Razorvine throw shown to prepare the B-side approach while your team sets up to defend A. The clip shows the launch and its B-side landing; follow its exact standing and release references. The creator does not name a more specific landing callout, so use the visual in the source rather than assuming one.

source.author: majimagaming
source.evidence: Tracker labels the clip Vyse Abyss defense and titles it 'B site pregame lineup'; the creator says it is a lineup to use while defending A. The embedded clip was played and visually reviewed: it shows a pre-round setup and a Razorvine landing on the B-side floor. Abyss remains in the current Competitive pool; Riot patch 13.08 lists Corrode as the map with geometry updates. Source reviewed; not tested in a live match.
source.rightsBasis: The clip remains embedded from its original Tracker page. No video, image, thumbnail or screenshot was copied or rehosted.
